findings.claim: The 20261110T074849Z bullet reports 'executed checks pass 20 of 20' without naming the SQLite or JDK version, while the earlier run names SQLite 3.51 and the v5 run names SQLite 3.53.2. A reader cannot tell which engine version the re-authored items (including 03 and 24, newly SQLite-executed) were first checked on.
findings.recommendation: State the SQLite and JDK versions for run 20261110T074849Z, or say the 3.51 bullet is the pre-re-authoring v3 run and the 20/20 count first held on the stated v5 versions.

findings.claim: Item 24 (prepared statements and SQL injection) is now listed as SQLite-executed. SQLite can show the SQL outcome of a concatenated versus bound value, but not pgJDBC parameter binding or PostgreSQL type coercion. The method row does not say which part was executed and which rests on documentation, as it does for item 16.
findings.recommendation: Qualify item 24 the way item 16 is qualified (for example 'the SQL outcome only'), and keep it in the Open item 4 PostgreSQL 18 run.
